compute_provenance: User-given comprehensive upper bound on all non-data computation between explicit global-data events; includes address, loop/control and arithmetic work. No target-CPU extraction is asserted.
private_provenance: User-given private-data service bound in a disjoint clean private partition; stack/spill/instruction effects must be included in the supplied comprehensive bounds. No platform calibration is asserted.
helper_provenance: User-given upper bound per noninitial marker, paid twice; two actual registered load changes separately cost one cycle each.
source_scope: fir2dim_main, both pin_down calls and checksum assignment; excludes fir2dim_init, outer entry/return wrapper; 782 explicit global-data accesses, not all machine memory accesses.
execution_scope: Independent cycle-level two-client model observation, not hardware or native four-client WCET. Serial preparation/cleanup added identically; reset is analysis-only and does not change physical policy.
budget_interpretation: User supplies receiver-only B. Carry admits iff Wcarry<=B. Any reported interval is derived from Wcarry/Wreset, not a predeclared application deadline.
